intent: An orchestrator and its sub-agents as a tree. Every node shows status, time and cost; branch costs roll up (Σ). Fold branches; approve or retry in place.
useWhen: show how an orchestrator split work into sub-agents
find which sub-agent waits or failed, and act on it
see cost roll up per branch
doNotUseWhen: agents side by side with a summary each — AgentFleet
one agent over time — AgentMonitor or AgentTrail
a file or category hierarchy — TreeView

root.note: { id, name, status: "queued" | "running" | "waiting" | "done" | "failed", elapsed?, cost?: number, note?, children? }. Missing root shows Empty.

folded.note: Folded branch ids; a folded branch shows "N agents".

onFoldedChange.note: (folded) => void. Adds the chevron disclosure on branches.

selectedId.note: Selected node id; its row shows the selected ring and its name button aria-pressed.

onSelect.note: (id) => void. Makes each node name a button, e.g. to open that agent's step elsewhere.

requirements: nested lists; branch chevrons are buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls
status is text in its own column; icons are aria-hidden
Approve and Retry name the node
fold and entry motion use opacity and transform, off under prefers-reduced-motion
with onSelect, node names are buttons named "<name>, <status>" with aria-pressed

doNot: Do not invent a local AgentTree, SubAgentList, or OrchestratorTree
Do not use TreeView for agent runs
Do not color status without the text label
snippet: <AgentTree root={{ id: "root", name: "Ship v2 billing", status: "running", elapsed: "8m 12s", children: [{ id: "r", name: "Research", status: "done", children: [{ id: "scan", name: "scan-codebase", status: "done", elapsed: "58s", cost: 0.14 }] }] }} folded={folded} onFoldedChange={setFolded} onApprove={approve} onRetry={retry} />
